## Welcome

## An exercise

```{webr}
# Compute the sum of 1 through 10.
______
```

::: { .hint exercise="first_exercise" }
The `sum()` function adds its arguments. Try `sum(1:10)`.
:::

## A quiz question

```{r}
#| echo: false
learnr2::question(
  "What does `sum(1:10)` return?",
  learnr2::answer("55", correct = TRUE),
  learnr2::answer("50"),
  learnr2::answer("100"),
  allow_retry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
  type = "reflection_editable",
  validate = "integer"
)
```
